notes: The margin Or, all this did Araunah the king give was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The article of הַכֹּל is read as taking the demonstrative this under rule 41; the competing reading marks it unrepresented and this added.
The article on the vocative הַמֶּלֶךְ is unrepresented and the noun holds the whole O king (rule 36).
